
```{r}
#| include: false
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) CAP <- "CDA Seismic Design Criteria by Consequence Classification. Source: CDA Technical Bulletin, Application of Dam Safety Guidelines to Mining Dams [-@cda2021], Table 3-3 (construction, operation and transition) and Table 4-2 (closure, passive care). The Canadian Dam Association (CDA) defines five consequence classifications, assigned from population at risk, loss of life, and environmental, cultural and economic losses. The tabulated levels are target levels for initial consideration and consultation between owner and regulator, not fixed requirements: the designer of record and the owner may adopt more stringent levels to further reduce risk, or less stringent ones where justified. The Maximum Credible Earthquake (MCE) is a stated alternative to the probabilistic level, not an upper envelope; CDA notes only that the MCE has no associated annual exceedance probability. Passive care is not abandonment: CDA requires a steady-state condition, demonstrated by accumulated experience and monitoring, before a facility enters that phase. CDA does not use OBE/SEE terminology; it specifies an Earthquake Design Ground Motion (EDGM)."
```

```{r}
#| include: true
#| label: tbl-cda
#| tbl-cap: !expr CAP
DT <- data.table(
  Class = c("Low", "Significant", "High", "Very High", "Extreme"),
  "Population at risk" = c(
    "None", "Temporary only", "Permanent", "Permanent", "Permanent"
  ),
  "Loss of life" = c(
    "0", "Unspecified", "10 or fewer", "100 or fewer", "More than 100"
  ),
  "Construction, operation, transition" = c(
    "1/100",
    "Between 1/100 and 1/1,000",
    "1/2,475",
    "Between 1/2,475 and 1/10,000, or MCE",
    "1/10,000, or MCE"
  ),
  "Closure, passive care" = c(
    "1/1,000",
    "1/2,475",
    "Between 1/2,475 and 1/10,000, or MCE",
    "1/10,000, or MCE",
    "1/10,000, or MCE"
  )
)

TBL <- DT |> buildTable(
    library = "flextable",
    align.body = "center",
    font.size.body = FONT.SIZE.BODY,
    font.size.header = FONT.SIZE.HEADER
) |>
  flextable::set_table_properties(layout = "autofit") |>
  flextable::align(align = "left", part = "all") |>
  flextable::footnote(
    i = 1, j = "Loss of life", part = "header",
    value = flextable::as_paragraph(
      "CDA Technical Bulletin Table 3-1, after Table 2-1 of the CDA Dam Safety Guidelines."
    ),
    ref_symbols = "*"
  ) |>
  flextable::footnote(
    i = 1, j = "Construction, operation, transition", part = "header",
    value = flextable::as_paragraph(
      "Annual exceedance probability for earthquakes, CDA Technical Bulletin Table 3-3. ",
      "The 1/2,475 level is anchored to the National Building Code of Canada."
    ),
    ref_symbols = "†"
  ) |>
  flextable::footnote(
    i = 1, j = "Closure, passive care", part = "header",
    value = flextable::as_paragraph(
      "Annual exceedance probability for earthquakes, CDA Technical Bulletin Table 4-2. ",
      "Closure under active care with regular monitoring retains the Table 3-3 levels."
    ),
    ref_symbols = "‡"
  )
TBL

```

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(CAP)
```
